text:
owen: heads up — linkcheck failed on the migration guide PR #1234, preview stuck on CI.

docs-bot: build 4827: docs-preview failed — linkcheck error: 1 broken link https://old.example.com/api (file: docs/migration/intro.md)

maya: @owen can you drop the linkfix? I can take reviewer duties if CI is green.

sven: I can do SDK snippet QA but I'm booked until ~15:00 PT; can do an initial pass then.

leah: happy to approve wording once the link is fixed. also might add a short example for header behavior.

kai: heads up — infra merge freeze 16:00-17:00 PT today. try to land before or after that window.

owen: noted re freeze. I'll open a tiny PR to replace the old host with new.example.com and mention redirect.

maya: thanks. @docs-bot please re-run preview after owen's PR is pushed.

docs-bot: queued re-run for PR #1235 — running linkcheck + static preview (ETA ~5m)

docs-bot: linkcheck passed; preview: https://redwood-inference.preview/pr-1235/migration/intro

sven: quick note — SDK snippet import path is outdated, change from `redwood.sdk` -> `redwood_inference.sdk`

maya: fixed the import, pushed commit.

leah: also added a short changelog bullet about host header semantics in migration/notes.md

maya: PR updated. @sven @leah can you re-approve? aiming to merge before freeze.

sven: approving now :thumbsup:

leah: approved — LGTM. :shipit:

kai: reminder — use `/merge docs` so the docs-merge queue handles sequencing (avoid conflicts during deploy).

owen: merged and deployed the docs site. filed INF-789 for CDN redirect rule to ensure old urls route correctly.

maya: added follow-up TODO in the guide for the redirect example and a tiny curl snippet:
`curl -I https://old.example.com/api | grep Location`

docs-bot: deploy 1291: docs site updated successfully, no regressions detected.
